title: Rear and Reversing Camera
summary: Feedback on the rear and reversing camera is mostly favorable for parking assistance and ease of use, but many excerpts are too brief or context-limited to classify confidently and one complaint mentions camera alignment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the camera system for making parking easier, improving confidence, and working very well as a standard feature.

negative.summary: Negative feedback is limited to a complaint that the reversing camera is off centre.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts mention the camera as helpful, usable, or hard to assess, but the examples are too brief or ambiguous to assign a clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: Many excerpts are very short or context-limited, so a large share of the topic cannot be assigned a clear sentiment.
Some undetermined examples contain seemingly positive or negative wording, but the provided labels and limited context prevent firmer interpretation.
